title: Inspect a ROOT histogram
summary: Read what a TH1D actually contains: total entries, a chosen bin, and summary statistics.
description: Implement HistogramInspection inspect_histogram(const TH1D& hist, int bin). Read the histogram without modifying it and return its total entries, the content of the requested ROOT bin, mean, and standard deviation.
requirements: Do not fill, reset, or otherwise modify the histogram.
Return GetBinContent(bin) for the requested ROOT bin number.
Return the histogram mean and standard deviation from ROOT's histogram statistics.

examples.explanation: Entries count observations; a bin content counts only observations represented by that bin.

hints: A histogram is data, not only a drawing. Inspect it through TH1D methods.
ROOT's visible x-axis bins are numbered starting at 1.
learning_goal: Distinguish total histogram entries from individual bin contents and inspect numerical summary statistics directly.

curriculum.competency: Inspect entries, bin contents and summary statistics of a TH1D instead of judging it only by its drawing.
curriculum.misconception: The histogram's total entries and the content of one visible bin are the same quantity.
curriculum.observable_success: The learner reports the total entries, requested bin content, mean, and standard deviation from a deterministic TH1D without modifying it.
curriculum.acceptance: Visible tests distinguish entries from selected bin contents and verify at least one bin-level observation.

es.title: Inspecciona un histograma ROOT
es.summary: Lee lo que realmente contiene un TH1D: entradas totales, un bin elegido y estadísticas resumen.
es.description: Implementa HistogramInspection inspect_histogram(const TH1D& hist, int bin). Lee el histograma sin modificarlo y devuelve sus entradas totales, el contenido del bin ROOT solicitado, la media y la desviación estándar.
requirements: No llenes, reinicies ni modifiques el histograma.
Devuelve GetBinContent(bin) para el número de bin ROOT solicitado.
Devuelve la media y la desviación estándar de las estadísticas del histograma.

examples.explanation: Entries cuenta observaciones; el contenido de un bin cuenta solo las observaciones representadas por ese bin.

hints: Un histograma son datos, no solo un dibujo. Inspecciónalo mediante métodos de TH1D.
Los bins visibles del eje x en ROOT se numeran desde 1.
es.learning_goal: Distinguir las entradas totales de un histograma del contenido de bins individuales e inspeccionar directamente sus estadísticas numéricas.
